subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Which open fix path should become canonical for this cron main-session skipped/disabled bug?
rationale: The source bug is valid, but the open PRs differ on whether to change only heartbeat gates or also cron queue retention, and automation should not choose that compatibility boundary without maintainer review.

options.title: Consolidate on a full cron/heartbeat fix
options.body: Choose a branch or replacement that covers both direct runHeartbeatOnce and queued requestHeartbeat cron paths, then require live cron proof before merge.

options.title: Accept a narrower heartbeat-gate fix
options.body: Land the smallest gate bypass if maintainers decide queued-event retention belongs in a separate issue or is already handled.

options.title: Pause the open candidates
options.body: Close or pause overlapping branches and keep this issue open until a maintainer-owned design is ready.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on a full cron/heartbeat fix
recommendation.body: Choose a branch or replacement that covers both direct runHeartbeatOnce and queued requestHeartbeat cron paths, then require live cron proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged the closest disabled-heartbeat cron retry and system-event cleanup work, making them the strongest available owner for the queue-retention versus heartbeat-gate boundary.
